title: Find the length of a list
description:
Find the length of your list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as list_length(lst), returning the number of items in lst.
hints: Python has a built-in function that reports how many items a sequence holds.
That function works directly on lists and returns an integer.
expected_behavior: Returns the length of the given list as an integer.
explanation: len() is the built-in way to get the number of items in any sequence, including a list.
